correctness.rationale: All 384 signed group elements, 70 absolute-interval elements and the entire 77/264/192-cell barycentric orbit complex are enumerated exactly. A maximal-tree CW presentation has 188 generators and 192 triangular attaching words. A complete 187-pair free-generator/two-cell cancellation leaves five attaching degrees (0,0,4,4,4) on one circle; two-cell slides reduce them to (4,0,0,0,0), certifying Moore(Z/4,1) wedge four S2. An independent exact integer differential and Smith-form computation corroborates Z/4 first homology and Z^4 second homology. All hypotheses, quotient conventions and degree normalization are explicit.

originality.rationale: The finite type-B4 Kreweras quotient under the rank-reversing order-eight map is not implied by the inspected type-B lattice theory, cyclic-sieving action results, or the closest exact Coxeter-conjugation quotient. The latter only divides by the order-four even-power subgroup and gives a different integral homology. A genuinely new attaching-map calculation yields Moore(Z/4,1) wedge four 2-spheres, subject to ordinary risk of unindexed prior work. In the full Bessis–Reiner preprint the full Kreweras action appears as Conjecture 6.5 (cyclic sieving), not as a quotient homotopy theorem.

value.rationale: Full Kreweras complement is the canonical Coxeter-theoretic rank-reversing symmetry, and its geometric orbit space is a natural, previously unstated topological invariant. The exact Moore-space-and-spheres homotopy type detects order-four fundamental-group torsion absent from the conjugation-only quotient and gives actual attaching maps, not merely a numerical count. There is a mathematically motivated extension to other reflection types without claiming such a theorem now.
